answer: The anchor schedule is applied in pulse and cedar makes public each instalment. A payout is split so that 48% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2350 identities would post 3060 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
